name: 52175 · West Union, IA
findings: ZIP 52175 (West Union) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52175 (West Union) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
78% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
